articles.title: Franklin Templeton adds $150 million in fund shares to XRP Ledger, all in one wallet
articles.snippet: Two subscriptions on Thursday nearly quadrupled the fund’s tokens on the network. The receiving wallet shares its authorized signers with the issuer.

articles.title: New York AG seeks $1.37B from NovaTech founders over Ponzi scheme
articles.snippet: The request follows an August 2025 default judgment, with the AG also announcing nearly $6 million in settlements with four promoters.

articles.title: Bybit secures first full Dubai license for spot trading services
articles.snippet: Bybit’s new VARA licence authorizes spot trading services in Dubai, but the exchange must complete additional regulatory requirements before launching.

articles.title: Bitcoin hashrate hits seven-month high as AI shift fails to ease mining competition
articles.snippet: According to BlocksBridge, Bitcoin’s mining difficulty is rising despite the industry’s AI transition, with smaller operators potentially absorbing equipment abandoned by larger competitors.

articles.title: Fireblocks disputes report of $2.5B Visa acquisition talks
articles.snippet: Fireblocks told Cointelegraph that reports of a potential $2.5 billion acquisition by Visa are “not true at present time,” while Visa declined to comment on the reported talks.
